scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm -w @tabletop/server run dev" "npm -w @tabletop/web run dev"
scripts.check: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:core && tsc -p packages/server && node test/run.mjs
